title: Refill the roadmap from a proactive opportunity scan and ship the top row
body:
Outcome: docs/program/roadmap.md holds at least three new ranked rows, each with a task carrying measured evidence, and the top one is delivered.
Why: after #488 no ready task can proceed (t-akp44kt waits ~30 PRs, t-zz33vhy waits 20 sessions); operator 2026-11-09: "nie wiem ogarnij to jakos" (full autonomy).
Proof: new task ids with evidence paths under .krn/runs/; first row merged.
Scope: this repository.
